_doc: Animal sprite sheets generated with ChatGPT (OpenAI image generation) on 2026-11-04. Every sheet: 1254x1254, 4 rows x 4 columns of equal 313.5px cells (row order up, left, down, right), 4 frames per row. Where a *_clean.png exists, use it (the original had a solid/fake background). Wired into data/animals.json through the game sheets scripts/build-animal-sheets.py makes (<id>/<id>_<action>_sheet.png); the boar sheets and fox walk came in later from the same series. 2026-11-09: stag and doe walk redrawn in this series (the two retro pixel walk sheets at the folder's top are no longer used), arctic fox death redrawn, and the farm animals pig, chicken, goat, cow, horse and duck added.
